channel.title: Flog It!
channel.desc: In Greater Manchester, over 800 people come along to have their items valued at Stockport Town Hall. Mark Stacey is wowed by a William De Morgan ceramic tile, Paul Martin finds some etchings by artist John Buckland Wright, and Philip Serrell discovers a gold necklace that surprises everyone at auction. Paul also takes time out to visit the Pankhurst Centre in Manchester.
